_note: Mock delivery/stock data for demo purposes only — not connected to a real warehouse or courier system. Keyed by category with a generic fallback.

default.dispatch: Same working day if ordered before 2pm
default.courier: Palletways / DPD (pallet or parcel depending on order size)

sample_delivery.note: Free samples, up to 5 per order

Solid Wood.note: Heavier pallet delivery, kerbside only — customer must arrange access for pallet trucks

Engineered Wood.note: Pallet delivery for large orders, parcel courier for small orders

Vinyl.note: Rolls delivered via dedicated courier for orders over 20m²

Herringbone.stock_level: In stock — some designs made to order
Herringbone.note: Certain herringbone patterns are made to order and may take longer — check individual product page

faq.question: How long does delivery take?
faq.answer: Most orders are dispatched same-day and arrive within 2-4 working days. Solid wood and herringbone products may take a little longer due to pallet delivery or made-to-order patterns.

faq.question: Is this in stock?
faq.answer: Yes, this product shows as in stock. Large orders are shipped via pallet; smaller orders via parcel courier.

faq.question: How much is delivery?
faq.answer: Standard delivery is £4.95, and free on orders over £300.

faq.question: Can I get a sample before I order?
faq.answer: Yes, free samples are available (up to 5 per order) and typically arrive within 2-3 working days.
